scope: Three supplied 2025 15-E papers used by the Previous Year Question Papers section
method: Questions were checked against the supplied paper text and, where available, KSEAB-style model-answer evidence. Corrections are kept in the answer-corrections layer so the source question paper remains unchanged.
notes: Quote-from-memory items intentionally provide a cue rather than reproducing the full prescribed extract.
Essay and letter answers are model responses; students may receive marks for other relevant, grammatically correct responses.
This audit concerns the three 2025 previous papers, not the entire independent question bank.
